<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Pilot Cohort Application | Intentional Data</title>
<meta name="description" content="Apply for the fall 2026 Co-Produced AI Governance pilot cohort, run by Intentional Data with Measure.">
<meta property="og:title" content="Co-Produced AI Governance: Pilot Cohort Application">
<meta property="og:description" content="Three to five organizations, one shared virtual room, three sessions. Free. Fall 2026.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Source+Sans+3:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&display=swap">
<style>
:root{
--ground:#FAF9F7; --surface:#FFFFFF; --surface-2:#F3F1EC; --wash:#F2F7EC;
--ink:#1D1D1B; --ink-2:#4A4A46; --ink-3:#7C7C74;
--line:#E3E1DB; --line-2:#D5D2C9;
--forest:#2D6A2F; --forest-dark:#1E4A20; --lime:#8CC63E; --orange:#C25A11; --orange-bright:#E87722;
--head:'Poppins','Segoe UI',Calibri,sans-serif;
--body:'Source Sans 3','Segoe UI',Calibri,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{color-scheme:light;}
body{
margin:0; background:var(--ground); color:var(--ink);
font-family:var(--body); font-size:17px; line-height:1.55;
-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
img{max-width:100%;}
/* ---------- top bar ---------- */
.topbar{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:20; background:var(--ground); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.topbar-inner{max-width:800px; margin:0 auto; padding:12px 24px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px;}
.lockup{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:13px; min-width:0;}
.mark-id{height:26px; width:auto;}
.mark-measure{height:19px; width:auto;}
.with{
font-family:var(--head); font-size:10.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.1em;
text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3); white-space:nowrap;
padding-left:13px; border-left:1px solid var(--line-2);
}
@media (max-width:620px){
.mark-id{height:19px;} .mark-measure{height:14px;}
.with{padding-left:8px; font-size:0; line-height:19px;}
.lockup{gap:8px;} .progress{display:none;} .progress-label{font-size:11px;}
.topbar-inner{padding:10px 18px; gap:10px;}
}
.progress-wrap{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-shrink:0;}
.progress-label{font-family:var(--head); font-size:10.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.progress{width:96px; height:5px; background:var(--line); border-radius:3px; overflow:hidden;}
.progress span{display:block; height:100%; width:0%; background:var(--forest); transition:width .25s ease;}
/* ---------- shell ---------- */
main{max-width:800px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 24px 96px;}
.hero{padding:52px 0 34px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.eyebrow{font-family:var(--head); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--orange); margin:0 0 12px;}
h1{font-family:var(--head); font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(32px,5.2vw,46px); line-height:1.08; letter-spacing:-.015em; color:var(--forest-dark); margin:0 0 16px; text-wrap:balance;}
.lede{font-size:19px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink-2); margin:0 0 26px; max-width:62ch;}
.facts{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin-bottom:26px;}
.fact{font-family:var(--head); font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:var(--ink-2); background:var(--surface-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:999px; padding:5px 13px;}
.hero-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:26px;}
@media (max-width:640px){ .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
.hero-block h2{font-family:var(--head); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--forest); margin:0 0 10px;}
ol.sessions{margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; counter-reset:s;}
ol.sessions li{counter-increment:s; position:relative; padding-left:30px; margin-bottom:7px; font-size:15.5px; color:var(--ink-2);}
ol.sessions li::before{
content:counter(s); position:absolute; left:0; top:1px; width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:50%;
background:var(--forest); color:#fff; font-family:var(--head); font-size:11px; font-weight:600;
display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}
ul.keeps{margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
ul.keeps li{position:relative; padding-left:16px; margin-bottom:7px; font-size:15.5px; color:var(--ink-2);}
ul.keeps li::before{content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:9px; width:6px; height:6px; background:var(--lime); border-radius:1px;}
/* ---------- sections ---------- */
section.step{padding:38px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.step-head{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; margin-bottom:6px;}
.step-num{font-family:var(--head); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.1em; color:var(--orange); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.step-head h2{font-family:var(--head); font-size:24px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.01em; color:var(--forest-dark); margin:0;}
.step-note{font-size:15.5px; color:var(--ink-3); margin:0 0 22px; max-width:60ch;}
.field{margin-bottom:20px;}
.field > label, .group > legend{display:block; font-family:var(--head); font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:6px; padding:0;}
.sub-label{font-family:var(--body); font-weight:400; font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-3); display:block; margin-bottom:6px;}
.req{color:var(--orange); font-weight:600;}
.hint{display:block; font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-3); margin:-2px 0 8px; font-weight:400; font-family:var(--body);}
input[type=text], input[type=email], input[type=tel], input[type=number], textarea, select{
width:100%; font-family:var(--body); font-size:16px; color:var(--ink);
background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius:5px; padding:10px 12px;
transition:border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
}
textarea{min-height:96px; resize:vertical; line-height:1.5;}
select{appearance:none; background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--ink-3) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ink-3) 50%,transparent 50%); background-position:calc(100% - 18px) 50%, calc(100% - 13px) 50%; background-size:5px 5px,5px 5px; background-repeat:no-repeat; padding-right:38px;}
input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, select:focus-visible{outline:none; border-color:var(--forest); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(45,106,47,.18);}
input.invalid, textarea.invalid, select.invalid{border-color:var(--orange-bright); background:#FDF4EC;}
.row{display:grid; gap:14px;}
.row-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
.row-3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;}
@media (max-width:640px){ .row-2,.row-3{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
fieldset.group{border:0; margin:0 0 20px; padding:0;}
.choices{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px;}
.choices.stack{flex-direction:column; gap:6px;}
.choice{
display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:9px; cursor:pointer; font-size:15.5px; color:var(--ink-2);
background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius:5px; padding:8px 13px;
transition:border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease;
}
.choice:hover{background:var(--surface-2);}
.choice input{margin:3px 0 0; accent-color:var(--forest); flex-shrink:0;}
.choice:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--forest); background:var(--wash);}
.choice input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--forest); outline-offset:2px;}
.seat{background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; padding:16px 16px 2px; margin-bottom:12px;}
.seat-label{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; margin-bottom:12px;}
.seat-name{font-family:var(--head); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--forest);}
.seat-tag{font-family:var(--head); font-size:10.5px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-3);}
.seat.lead{border-left:3px solid var(--forest);}
.callout{background:var(--wash); border-left:3px solid var(--lime); padding:14px 18px; margin:0 0 22px; font-size:15.5px; color:var(--ink-2);}
.callout b{color:var(--forest-dark); font-family:var(--head); font-weight:600;}
.hp{position:absolute; left:-9999px; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden;}
.submit-bar{padding:34px 0 0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; align-items:flex-start;}
button.primary{font-family:var(--head); font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:#fff; background:var(--forest); border:0; border-radius:6px; padding:14px 30px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease, transform .05s ease;}
button.primary:hover{background:var(--forest-dark);}
button.primary:active{transform:translateY(1px);}
button.primary:disabled{opacity:.55; cursor:progress;}
button.ghost{font-family:var(--head); font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:var(--forest); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius:6px; padding:9px 18px; cursor:pointer;}
button.ghost:hover{background:var(--surface-2);}
button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--forest); outline-offset:2px;}
.error-note{display:none; font-size:15px; color:var(--orange); font-family:var(--head); font-weight:500;}
.error-note.show{display:block;}
.saved-note{font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-3);}
footer{padding:30px 0 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); margin-top:38px; font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-3); display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px 18px; justify-content:space-between;}
footer a{color:var(--forest); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);}
#confirm{display:none; padding:64px 0 40px;}
#confirm.show{display:block;}
#form-view.hide{display:none;}
.confirm-mark{width:46px; height:46px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--forest); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:22px;}
.confirm-mark svg{width:24px; height:24px;}
#confirm h1{font-size:clamp(28px,4.4vw,38px);}
.next-list{margin:26px 0 0; padding:0; list-style:none; border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
.next-list li{padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:16px; color:var(--ink-2);}
.next-list b{font-family:var(--head); font-weight:600; color:var(--ink); display:block; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:3px;}
.copy-box{margin-top:26px; background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; padding:18px;}
.copy-box h3{font-family:var(--head); font-size:13px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--forest); margin:0 0 8px;}
.copy-box p{margin:0 0 14px; font-size:15.5px; color:var(--ink-2);}
.copy-actions{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;}
pre.record{margin:14px 0 0; padding:14px; background:var(--surface-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:5px; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; max-height:260px; overflow:auto; color:var(--ink-2); font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;}
@media print{ .topbar{position:static;} }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ *{transition:none !important; animation:none !important;} }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="topbar">
<div class="topbar-inner">

<main>
<div id="form-view">
<div class="hero">
<p class="eyebrow">Application &middot; Fall 2026 pilot cohort</p>
<h1>Co-Produced AI Governance</h1>
<p class="lede">Three to five organizations, one shared virtual room, three sessions. Your team leaves able to evaluate tools, set policy, and answer to your community about how you use AI, without us in the room.</p>
<div class="facts">
<span class="fact">3 sessions</span>
<span class="fact">90 minutes each</span>
<span class="fact">Virtual</span>
<span class="fact">Up to 5 seats per organization</span>
<span class="fact">No cost</span>
<span class="fact">Fall 2026</span>
</div>
<div class="hero-grid">
<div class="hero-block">
<h2>The three sessions</h2>
<ol class="sessions">
<li>AI literacy and demystification</li>
<li>Governance foundations</li>
<li>Evaluating AI tools</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="hero-block">
<h2>What your organization keeps</h2>
<ul class="keeps">
<li>Literacy diagnostic results, before and after</li>
<li>Scenario sorting worksheet, which becomes your first use policy</li>
<li>Tool evaluation rubric, 20 criteria</li>
<li>Leadership commitment document</li>
<li>Point-in-time upskilling report for funders and your board</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<form id="app-form" novalidate>
<div class="hp" aria-hidden="true"><label for="website2">Leave this field empty</label><input type="text" id="website2" name="website2" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></div>
<section class="step">
<div class="step-head"><span class="step-num">01</span><h2>Your organization</h2></div>
<p class="step-note">Takes about ten minutes. Your answers save in this browser as you go.</p>
<div class="field">
<label for="org_name">Organization name <span class="req">*</span></label>
<input type="text" id="org_name" name="org_name" data-required autocomplete="organization">
</div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field">
<label for="org_site">Website or social page</label>
<input type="text" id="org_site" name="org_site" placeholder="A link where we can see your work">
</div>
<div class="field">
<label for="org_area">City and service area <span class="req">*</span></label>
<input type="text" id="org_area" name="org_area" data-required>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field">
<label for="org_mission_t">What your organization does, in two sentences <span class="req">*</span></label>
<textarea id="org_mission_t" name="org_mission_t" data-required></textarea>
</div>
<div class="field">
<label for="org_community">Who you serve <span class="req">*</span></label>
<span class="hint">The communities you are accountable to. This shapes how the sessions are taught.</span>
<textarea id="org_community" name="org_community" data-required></textarea>
</div>
<div class="field">
<label for="org_budget">Annual operating budget <span class="req">*</span></label>
<select id="org_budget" name="org_budget" data-required>
<option value="">Select a range</option>
<option>Under $100k</option>
<option>$100k to $500k</option>
<option>$500k to $1M</option>
<option>$1M to $5M</option>
<option>Over $5M</option>
<option>Prefer to discuss</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="field">
<label>People who do the work <span class="req">*</span></label>
<span class="hint">Approximate headcount is fine.</span>
<div class="row row-3">
<div><span class="sub-label"><label for="ppl_ft">Paid full time</label></span><input type="number" min="0" id="ppl_ft" name="ppl_ft" data-required></div>
<div><span class="sub-label"><label for="ppl_pt">Paid part time</label></span><input type="number" min="0" id="ppl_pt" name="ppl_pt" data-required></div>
<div><span class="sub-label"><label for="ppl_vol">Regular volunteers</label></span><input type="number" min="0" id="ppl_vol" name="ppl_vol" data-required></div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="step">
<div class="step-head"><span class="step-num">02</span><h2>Contacts</h2></div>
<p class="step-note">One person we reach with logistics, and the person who leads the organization.</p>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="pc_name">Primary contact name <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="text" id="pc_name" name="pc_name" data-required autocomplete="name"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="pc_role">Their role <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="text" id="pc_role" name="pc_role" data-required></div>
</div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="pc_email">Email <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="email" id="pc_email" name="pc_email" data-required autocomplete="email"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="pc_phone">Phone</label><input type="tel" id="pc_phone" name="pc_phone" autocomplete="tel"></div>
</div>
<label class="choice" style="max-width:420px; margin-bottom:16px;">
<input type="checkbox" id="same_lead" name="same_lead">
<span>I am the person who leads this organization</span>
</label>
<div id="lead-fields" class="row row-3">
<div class="field"><label for="ld_name">Organization lead, name <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="text" id="ld_name" name="ld_name" data-required></div>
<div class="field"><label for="ld_role">Their role <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="text" id="ld_role" name="ld_role" data-required></div>
<div class="field"><label for="ld_email">Their email <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="email" id="ld_email" name="ld_email" data-required></div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="step">
<div class="step-head"><span class="step-num">03</span><h2>Your team</h2></div>
<p class="step-note">Up to five seats. The same team attends all three sessions, so bring the people who will carry this afterward. Volunteers and board members count as seats. Bring fewer if your team is smaller.</p>
<div class="callout">
<b>What makes a strong team.</b> Whoever leads the organization, whoever handles your tools and systems, and at least one person close to the community-facing work. Three people wearing all of those hats is a real team for this.
</div>
<div class="seat lead">
<div class="seat-label"><span class="seat-name">Seat 1</span><span class="seat-tag">Organization lead, required</span></div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="s1_name">Name <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="text" id="s1_name" name="s1_name" data-required></div>
<div class="field"><label for="s1_email">Email <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="email" id="s1_email" name="s1_email" data-required></div>
</div>
<div class="field"><label for="s1_role">Role in the organization <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="text" id="s1_role" name="s1_role" data-required></div>
</div>
<div class="seat">
<div class="seat-label"><span class="seat-name">Seat 2</span><span class="seat-tag">Optional</span></div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="s2_name">Name</label><input type="text" id="s2_name" name="s2_name"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="s2_email">Email</label><input type="email" id="s2_email" name="s2_email"></div>
</div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="s2_role">Role</label><input type="text" id="s2_role" name="s2_role"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="s2_type">They are</label>
<select id="s2_type" name="s2_type"><option value="">Select</option><option>Director or founder</option><option>Program or direct service</option><option>Operations, admin, or finance</option><option>Volunteer</option><option>Board member</option><option>Part time or contract</option></select>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="seat">
<div class="seat-label"><span class="seat-name">Seat 3</span><span class="seat-tag">Optional</span></div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="s3_name">Name</label><input type="text" id="s3_name" name="s3_name"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="s3_email">Email</label><input type="email" id="s3_email" name="s3_email"></div>
</div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="s3_role">Role</label><input type="text" id="s3_role" name="s3_role"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="s3_type">They are</label>
<select id="s3_type" name="s3_type"><option value="">Select</option><option>Director or founder</option><option>Program or direct service</option><option>Operations, admin, or finance</option><option>Volunteer</option><option>Board member</option><option>Part time or contract</option></select>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="seat">
<div class="seat-label"><span class="seat-name">Seat 4</span><span class="seat-tag">Optional</span></div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="s4_name">Name</label><input type="text" id="s4_name" name="s4_name"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="s4_email">Email</label><input type="email" id="s4_email" name="s4_email"></div>
</div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="s4_role">Role</label><input type="text" id="s4_role" name="s4_role"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="s4_type">They are</label>
<select id="s4_type" name="s4_type"><option value="">Select</option><option>Director or founder</option><option>Program or direct service</option><option>Operations, admin, or finance</option><option>Volunteer</option><option>Board member</option><option>Part time or contract</option></select>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="seat">
<div class="seat-label"><span class="seat-name">Seat 5</span><span class="seat-tag">Optional</span></div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="s5_name">Name</label><input type="text" id="s5_name" name="s5_name"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="s5_email">Email</label><input type="email" id="s5_email" name="s5_email"></div>
</div>
<div class="row row-2">
<div class="field"><label for="s5_role">Role</label><input type="text" id="s5_role" name="s5_role"></div>
<div class="field"><label for="s5_type">They are</label>
<select id="s5_type" name="s5_type"><option value="">Select</option><option>Director or founder</option><option>Program or direct service</option><option>Operations, admin, or finance</option><option>Volunteer</option><option>Board member</option><option>Part time or contract</option></select>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field">
<label for="alternates">Alternates</label>
<span class="hint">Two names we can call on if a seat opens up. Name and email each.</span>
<textarea id="alternates" name="alternates" style="min-height:70px"></textarea>
</div>
</section>
<section class="step">
<div class="step-head"><span class="step-num">04</span><h2>Where you are with AI</h2></div>
<p class="step-note">Answer as things actually are today. Starting from zero is a fine place to start.</p>
<fieldset class="group">
<legend>Where AI shows up in your work now</legend>
<span class="hint">Check everything that applies.</span>
<div class="choices">
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="use" value="Writing and communications"><span>Writing and communications</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="use" value="Grant writing"><span>Grant writing</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="use" value="Data analysis"><span>Data analysis</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="use" value="Client or case records"><span>Client or case records</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="use" value="Scheduling"><span>Scheduling</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="use" value="Chatbots facing community members"><span>Chatbots facing community members</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="use" value="None yet"><span>None yet</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="use" value="Unsure"><span>Unsure</span></label>
</div>
</fieldset>
<fieldset class="group">
<legend>Written AI use policy <span class="req">*</span></legend>
<div class="choices">
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="policy" value="Yes" data-required><span>Yes</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="policy" value="In draft"><span>In draft</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="policy" value="No"><span>No</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="policy" value="Unsure"><span>Unsure</span></label>
</div>
</fieldset>
<fieldset class="group">
<legend>Roughly how many of your people use AI tools <span class="req">*</span></legend>
<div class="choices">
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="howmany" value="None" data-required><span>None</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="howmany" value="A few"><span>A few</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="howmany" value="About half"><span>About half</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="howmany" value="Most"><span>Most</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="howmany" value="Unsure"><span>Unsure</span></label>
</div>
</fieldset>
<fieldset class="group">
<legend>Does any tool you use touch community or client data <span class="req">*</span></legend>
<div class="choices">
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="clientdata" value="Yes" data-required><span>Yes</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="clientdata" value="No"><span>No</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="clientdata" value="Unsure"><span>Unsure</span></label>
</div>
</fieldset>
<div class="field">
<label for="clientdata_detail">If yes or unsure, tell us in one line what that looks like</label>
<input type="text" id="clientdata_detail" name="clientdata_detail">
</div>
<div class="field">
<label for="why_now">What prompted your interest now <span class="req">*</span></label>
<span class="hint">A hundred words is plenty.</span>
<textarea id="why_now" name="why_now" data-required></textarea>
</div>
</section>
<section class="step">
<div class="step-head"><span class="step-num">05</span><h2>Capacity</h2></div>
<p class="step-note">Scheduling gets set with the whole cohort once organizations are selected.</p>
<fieldset class="group">
<legend>Can your team attend all three sessions live <span class="req">*</span></legend>
<div class="choices">
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="attend" value="Yes" data-required><span>Yes</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="attend" value="Most of them"><span>Most of them</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="attend" value="Depends on scheduling"><span>Depends on scheduling</span></label>
</div>
</fieldset>
<fieldset class="group">
<legend>Windows that work for your team <span class="req">*</span></legend>
<span class="hint">Check everything workable.</span>
<div class="choices">
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="window" value="Weekday morning" data-required-group="window"><span>Weekday morning</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="window" value="Weekday midday"><span>Weekday midday</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="window" value="Weekday afternoon"><span>Weekday afternoon</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="window" value="Weekday evening"><span>Weekday evening</span></label>
</div>
</fieldset>
<div class="field">
<label for="months">Months that work best</label>
<input type="text" id="months" name="months" placeholder="For example, October and November">
</div>
<div class="field">
<label for="barriers">Anything that would make participation hard</label>
<span class="hint">Accessibility needs, connectivity, language, staff and volunteer time. Tell us so we can build around it.</span>
<textarea id="barriers" name="barriers" style="min-height:80px"></textarea>
</div>
</section>
<section class="step">
<div class="step-head"><span class="step-num">06</span><h2>What we ask of you</h2></div>
<p class="step-note">Four commitments. All four are required for the pilot to produce anything useful for your organization.</p>
<div class="choices stack">
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="commit" value="Readiness assessment" data-required><span>The person leading our organization completes the readiness assessment before session one.</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="commit" value="Diagnostic before and after" data-required><span>Everyone attending takes the literacy diagnostic before the first session and after the last one.</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="commit" value="Attend all three" data-required><span>Our team attends all three sessions.</span></label>
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="commit" value="Anonymized case study" data-required><span>Our results may appear in anonymized form in the pilot case study, and we see it before anything is published.</span></label>
</div>
<div style="margin-top:22px">
<div class="choices stack">
<label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="reference" value="Willing to be a public reference"><span><b style="font-family:var(--head);font-weight:600">Optional.</b> We would consider being named publicly as a pilot organization and serving as a reference for funders. Checking this commits you to nothing; we would ask you again before using your name.</span></label>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="step" style="border-bottom:0">
<div class="step-head"><span class="step-num">07</span><h2>Anything else</h2></div>
<p class="step-note">Questions, context, or anything that would not fit above.</p>
<div class="field">
<label for="anything" style="position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)">Anything else we should know</label>
<textarea id="anything" name="anything" style="min-height:110px"></textarea>
</div>
<div class="submit-bar">
<button type="submit" class="primary" id="submit-btn">Submit application</button>
<p class="error-note" id="err">Some required answers are still open. We moved you to the first one.</p>
<p class="saved-note" id="saved">Your answers save in this browser as you type.</p>
</div>
</section>
</form>
<footer>
<span>Intentional Data &middot; Ethical and Efficient</span>
<span><a href="mailto:dominique.charlie@intentionaldata.org">dominique.charlie@intentionaldata.org</a></span>
</footer>
</div>
<div id="confirm">
<div class="confirm-mark" aria-hidden="true">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 12.5l5.2 5.2L20 7"/></svg>
</div>
<p class="eyebrow" id="confirm-eyebrow">Application received</p>
<h1 id="confirm-head">Thank you</h1>
<p class="lede" id="confirm-lede">Your application is in. Intentional Data and Measure review applications together and select the cohort jointly.</p>
<ul class="next-list" id="next-list">
<li><b>Review</b>We read every application and look at the cohort as a whole, since the room works best with a range of sizes and starting points.</li>
<li><b>A short conversation</b>We may reach out with a question or two before deciding.</li>
<li><b>Word either way</b>Every organization that applies hears back from us by email.</li>
</ul>
<div class="copy-box">
<h3>Keep a copy</h3>
<p id="copy-blurb">A record of what you submitted, for your files.</p>
<div class="copy-actions">
<button type="button" class="ghost" id="copy-btn">Copy to clipboard</button>
<button type="button" class="ghost" id="dl-btn">Download as a text file</button>
</div>
<pre class="record" id="record"></pre>
</div>
</div>
</main>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
/* Google Apps Script web app URL. Replace after deploying the script behind the sheet. */
var ENDPOINT = 'PASTE_APPS_SCRIPT_URL_HERE';
var form = document.getElementById('app-form');
var STORE = 'id-pilot-application-v1';
function radioAnswered(name){ return !!form.querySelector('input[name="'+name+'"]:checked'); }
function checklist(){
var items = [];
form.querySelectorAll('input[data-required], textarea[data-required], select[data-required]').forEach(function(el){
if(el.type === 'radio'){
if(!items.some(function(i){return i.key === 'r:'+el.name;})) items.push({key:'r:'+el.name, ok:radioAnswered(el.name), el:el});
} else if(el.type === 'checkbox'){
items.push({key:'c:'+el.name+':'+el.value, ok:el.checked, el:el});
} else {
if(el.closest('#lead-fields') && document.getElementById('same_lead').checked) return;
items.push({key:'f:'+el.id, ok:String(el.value).trim().length > 0, el:el});
}
});
var win = form.querySelector('[data-required-group="window"]');
if(win) items.push({key:'g:window', ok:radioAnswered('window'), el:win});
return items;
}
function updateProgress(){
var items = checklist();
var done = items.filter(function(i){return i.ok;}).length;
var pct = items.length ? Math.round(done / items.length * 100) : 0;
document.getElementById('bar').style.width = pct + '%';
document.getElementById('pct').textContent = pct + '%';
document.querySelector('.progress').setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(pct));
}
function collect(){
var d = {};
form.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(function(el){
if(!el.name) return;
if(el.type === 'checkbox'){
if(el.name === 'same_lead') return;
if(!d[el.name]) d[el.name] = [];
if(el.checked) d[el.name].push(el.value === 'on' ? true : el.value);
} else if(el.type === 'radio'){
if(el.checked) d[el.name] = el.value;
} else {
d[el.name] = el.value;
}
});
d.same_lead = document.getElementById('same_lead').checked;
return d;
}
function restore(){
var raw = null;
try { raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE); } catch(e){ return; }
if(!raw) return;
var d;
try { d = JSON.parse(raw); } catch(e){ return; }
form.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(function(el){
if(!el.name || !(el.name in d)) return;
var v = d[el.name];
if(el.type === 'checkbox'){ el.checked = Array.isArray(v) ? v.indexOf(el.value) !== -1 : !!v; }
else if(el.type === 'radio'){ el.checked = (v === el.value); }
else { el.value = v; }
});
document.getElementById('same_lead').checked = !!d.same_lead;
document.getElementById('saved').textContent = 'We restored the answers you started earlier in this browser.';
}
function save(){ try { localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(collect())); } catch(e){} }
function syncLead(){ document.getElementById('lead-fields').style.display = document.getElementById('same_lead').checked ? 'none' : ''; }
form.addEventListener('input', function(){ save(); updateProgress(); });
form.addEventListener('change', function(e){
if(e.target.id === 'same_lead') syncLead();
save(); updateProgress();
if(e.target.classList) e.target.classList.remove('invalid');
});
function validate(){
var items = checklist();
var bad = items.filter(function(i){return !i.ok;});
items.forEach(function(i){
var el = i.el;
if(el && el.classList && el.type !== 'checkbox' && el.type !== 'radio'){ el.classList.toggle('invalid', !i.ok); }
});
var email = document.getElementById('pc_email');
if(email.value && !/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email.value)){ email.classList.add('invalid'); bad.push({el:email}); }
return bad;
}
function recordText(rec){
var d = rec.data, lines = [];
lines.push('AI GOVERNANCE PILOT COHORT APPLICATION');
lines.push('Submitted ' + rec.received);
lines.push('');
lines.push('ORGANIZATION');
lines.push('Name: ' + (d.org_name||''));
lines.push('Website: ' + (d.org_site||''));
lines.push('City and service area: ' + (d.org_area||''));
lines.push('What we do: ' + (d.org_mission_t||''));
lines.push('Who we serve: ' + (d.org_community||''));
lines.push('Budget: ' + (d.org_budget||''));
lines.push('People: ' + (d.ppl_ft||'0') + ' full time, ' + (d.ppl_pt||'0') + ' part time, ' + (d.ppl_vol||'0') + ' regular volunteers');
lines.push('');
lines.push('CONTACTS');
lines.push('Primary: ' + (d.pc_name||'') + ', ' + (d.pc_role||'') + ', ' + (d.pc_email||'') + (d.pc_phone ? ', ' + d.pc_phone : ''));
lines.push('Organization lead: ' + (d.same_lead ? 'same as primary contact' : ((d.ld_name||'') + ', ' + (d.ld_role||'') + ', ' + (d.ld_email||''))));
lines.push('');
lines.push('TEAM');
for(var i=1;i<=5;i++){
var n = d['s'+i+'_name'];
if(n && n.trim()){
lines.push('Seat ' + i + ': ' + n + ', ' + (d['s'+i+'_role']||'') + ', ' + (d['s'+i+'_email']||'') + (d['s'+i+'_type'] ? ' (' + d['s'+i+'_type'] + ')' : (i===1 ? ' (organization lead)' : '')));
}
}
if(d.alternates && d.alternates.trim()) lines.push('Alternates: ' + d.alternates);
lines.push('');
lines.push('WHERE WE ARE WITH AI');
lines.push('AI shows up in: ' + ((d.use||[]).join('; ') || 'nothing selected'));
lines.push('Written policy: ' + (d.policy||''));
lines.push('People using AI tools: ' + (d.howmany||''));
lines.push('Touches community or client data: ' + (d.clientdata||'') + (d.clientdata_detail ? ' (' + d.clientdata_detail + ')' : ''));
lines.push('What prompted this: ' + (d.why_now||''));
lines.push('');
lines.push('CAPACITY');
lines.push('Can attend all three: ' + (d.attend||''));
lines.push('Windows: ' + ((d.window||[]).join('; ')));
lines.push('Months: ' + (d.months||''));
lines.push('Barriers: ' + (d.barriers||'none noted'));
lines.push('');
lines.push('COMMITMENTS');
lines.push('Agreed to: ' + ((d.commit||[]).join('; ')));
lines.push('Public reference: ' + ((d.reference||[]).length ? 'yes, open to it' : 'no'));
lines.push('');
lines.push('ANYTHING ELSE');
lines.push(d.anything || 'nothing added');
return lines.join('\n');
}
function showConfirm(rec, sent){
document.getElementById('form-view').classList.add('hide');
document.getElementById('confirm').classList.add('show');
document.getElementById('record').textContent = recordText(rec);
window.__record = recordText(rec);
if(!sent){
document.getElementById('confirm-eyebrow').textContent = 'One more step';
document.getElementById('confirm-head').textContent = 'Send us your application';
document.getElementById('confirm-lede').textContent = 'Your answers are complete and saved below. They could not reach us automatically, so copy or download the record and email it to dominique.charlie@intentionaldata.org. We will confirm receipt.';
document.getElementById('copy-blurb').textContent = 'Copy or download this, then email it to dominique.charlie@intentionaldata.org.';
document.getElementById('next-list').style.display = 'none';
} else {
try { localStorage.removeItem(STORE); } catch(e){}
}
window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'});
}
function post(payload){
return fetch(ENDPOINT, {
method:'POST',
headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'},
body: JSON.stringify(payload)
}).then(function(r){
return r.text().then(function(t){
try { var j = JSON.parse(t); return !!j.ok; } catch(e){ return r.ok; }
});
});
}
form.addEventListener('submit', function(ev){
ev.preventDefault();
var bad = validate();
var err = document.getElementById('err');
if(bad.length){
err.classList.add('show');
var first = bad[0].el;
if(first && first.scrollIntoView){
first.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});
if(first.focus) setTimeout(function(){ first.focus({preventScroll:true}); }, 350);
}
return;
}
err.classList.remove('show');
var btn = document.getElementById('submit-btn');
btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Sending';
var rec = {received:new Date().toLocaleString(), data:collect()};
var payload = {};
Object.keys(rec.data).forEach(function(k){
var v = rec.data[k];
payload[k] = Array.isArray(v) ? v.join('; ') : v;
});
payload.submitted_at = rec.received;
post(payload).then(function(ok){
btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Submit application';
showConfirm(rec, ok);
}).catch(function(){
/* opaque fallback: the browser blocked reading the response, so send it blind */
fetch(ENDPOINT, {method:'POST', mode:'no-cors', headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}, body:JSON.stringify(payload)})
.then(function(){ btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Submit application'; showConfirm(rec, true); })
.catch(function(){ btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Submit application'; showConfirm(rec, false); });
});
});
document.getElementById('copy-btn').addEventListener('click', function(){
var btn = this, t = window.__record || '';
if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).then(function(){ btn.textContent = 'Copied'; setTimeout(function(){ btn.textContent = 'Copy to clipboard'; }, 2200); },
function(){ btn.textContent = 'Select the text below to copy'; });
} else { btn.textContent = 'Select the text below to copy'; }
});
document.getElementById('dl-btn').addEventListener('click', function(){
var blob = new Blob([window.__record || ''], {type:'text/plain'});
var a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
a.download = 'ai-governance-pilot-application.txt';
document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); a.remove(); }, 1000);
this.textContent = 'Downloaded';
});
restore();
syncLead();
updateProgress();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
